name: Tidepool Meadow
blurb: Warm pools and very polite snails.
stories: {pet} counted the starfish, lost count, and was happy about it.
{pet} made friends with a snail and walked at snail speed all afternoon.
{pet} napped in a warm pool and came home smelling of seaweed.
{pet} chased one bubble all the way across the meadow.

name: Driftwood Cove
blurb: Smooth sticks, slow boats and quiet benches.
stories: {pet} dragged a very large stick home and will not explain.
{pet} sat on a driftwood bench and waved at every boat.
{pet} found a bottle with no message, which felt like a message.
{pet} learned that driftwood makes a surprisingly good drum.

name: Sandcastle Shallows
blurb: Moats, turrets and one very brave wave.
stories: {pet} built a castle, welcomed one wave, and called it a draw.
{pet} patrolled the sandy moat with great ceremony.
{pet} buried a treasure and proudly forgot where.
{pet} was crowned king of the sandcastle for one whole minute.

name: Kelp Forest Library
blurb: Hushed shelves under a roof of kelp.
stories: {pet} read the quiet shelves and nodded at all the good parts.
{pet} was gently shushed by a very kind octopus librarian.
{pet} borrowed a book about tides and came back with a bookmark.
{pet} dozed off on a soft stack of bedtime stories.

name: Lantern Lagoon
blurb: A lagoon that glows when it is happy.
stories: {pet} followed the glowing jellies until the water turned gold.
{pet} caught a lantern's reflection and kept it in a pocket.
{pet} hummed along with the lagoon, and the lagoon hummed back.
{pet} watched the lights drift by and forgot to be hungry.

name: Coral Bakery Reef
blurb: Warm rolls and cooling racks by the reef.
stories: {pet} helped knead the dough and ended up mostly flour.
{pet} was handed a warm kelp roll and an even warmer smile.
{pet} guarded the cooling rack with deadly seriousness.
{pet} decided that sea-salt caramel is a feeling, not a flavour.

name: Moonpearl Isles
blurb: Pearl-lit islands where the tide tucks you in.
stories: {pet} slept under three moons' worth of pearl light.
{pet} drifted between islands on a quilt of moonlit foam.
{pet} whispered a wish to a pearl, and the pearl kept it safe.
{pet} was tucked in by the tide and told a very long goodnight.

name: Starfall Sandbar
blurb: A sandbar for stargazing and big wishes.
stories: {pet} caught a falling star and set it gently back in the sky.
{pet} danced on the sandbar while the stars kept time.
{pet} carried home a shell full of stardust, careful as soup.
{pet} stayed up late and made a wish on everyone's behalf.
